name: uci-loss-audit-v1
question: Which search limitations first drive Searched Locked-3's losses to Stockfish-100?
domain: The 31 lost games from uci-playing-pilot-v1; development-only
oracle: Stockfish 18 depth 12, MultiPV 1, Threads 1, Hash 16 MB
positions: Every candidate-to-move position after the frozen eight-ply opening
regret: Side-to-move difference between root best and root-move-constrained played move, clipped to ±2000 cp

first_error_rule.preferred: Earliest major error whose played-move value is at least 300 cp adverse and whose next candidate-turn root remains at least 300 cp adverse
first_error_rule.fallback: Earliest major error, otherwise maximum-regret candidate move

guardrail: Exploratory development audit only. No candidate advances without a new preregistered opening-suite confirmation.
